name: Kalam: one match, turn by turn
description: Claim ONE queued row on this replica's engine digest and play it: observe, one `model_infer` per live seat, step, until the engine stops returning views. The row is finished in place, with its replay under a key naming the attempt. Every statement is conditioned on the claim token, so a stale attempt updates nothing. It reads no rating and writes no rating, and its database role cannot reach one. In `api` mode every statement is a call to Soma's runner gate (/v1/runner/*). On SIGTERM Orion stops claiming and lets the match in hand finish inside cron.shutdown_timeout_secs.
